english.title: Erect / retain scaffolding on a highway without section 169 licence or fail to comply with terms/duty
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in connection with

(A)_[building work]_
(B)_[demolition work]_
(C)_[the alteration of a building]_
(D)_[the repair of a building]_
(E)_[the maintenance of a building]_
(F)_[the cleaning of a building]_

at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..),

(G)_[erected]_
(H)_[retained]_

on or over the highway scaffolding or other structure which obstructed the highway

(I)_[when not authorised to do so by a licence in writing issued by **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY AUTHORITY..) for the purposes of section 169]_
(J)_[and, without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with the terms, namely **(..SPECIFY TERMS..) of a licence issued under section 169(1)]_
(K)_[and, without reasonable excuse, failed to perform a duty, namely **(..SPECIFY DUTY..) imposed on you by section 169(4)]_

of the Highways Act 1980
english.legislation: Contrary to section 169(5) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
contravened the provisions of s.169(1)
other than by failure to comply with a licence
fail without reasonable excuse
to comply with terms of licence /
perform a s.169(4) duty

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 169(6) and (7) of the Highways Act 1980.for what can or cannot constitute a structure.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.
